name: Isabela Cruz
bio:
Isabela is a brilliant and ambitious engineer who has quickly risen through the ranks in the motorsport world. Born and raised in San Juan, she always had a fascination with speed and mechanics, fueling her drive to excel in a male-dominated field. While fiercely independent and career-focused, she also enjoys the finer things in life, appreciating luxury and glamour. 

Despite her materialistic tendencies, Isabela is looking for a genuine connection with someone who values her for more than just her success. She desires a partner who understands the demands of her career and is willing to share in her opulent lifestyle. While marriage is on her mind, children are not, and she seeks someone who can appreciate quality time and a vibrant social life as much as she does.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair styled in a balayage with sun-kissed highlights.
physical.description: Isabela has a striking presence with high cheekbones and a confident smile. She favors bohemian-inspired jewelry that accentuates her natural beauty.

meetingContext: At a team launch party, where she is consulting on the aerodynamics of the new car.
firstImpression: She stands out immediately, not just for her beauty, but for the way she confidently navigates the room, engaging in discussions with a knowing smile.
loveLanguage: Gifts - Isabela appreciates thoughtful, luxurious gifts that show you understand her tastes and desires.
